name: Loan Lead
description: Pre-application stage: a vendor's expression of interest / eligibility pre-screening, before a formal Loan Application exists. Frappe Lending (the `lending` app) has no equivalent concept — its Loan Application is the first doctype in its own flow. Converts 1:1 into a Loan Application once basic eligibility is confirmed.

fields.label: Vendor Lead (CRM)
fields.description: The vendor lead pipeline record (owned by the crm app) this loan interest originated from.

fields.label: Tenant
fields.description: Row-level isolation key (spec §3.2B) — the vendor's anchor/cluster.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
New
Eligibility Check
Eligible
Ineligible
Converted
Dropped

fields.label: Applicant (Borrower) Contact Details
fields.description: Field names deliberately match Frappe Lending's Loan Application applicant_* fields for direct passthrough on conversion.

fields.label: Performed By Agent
fields.description: Set automatically when a Field Agent creates/edits this record on the vendor's behalf (spec §4.3 proxy-action pattern).

fields.label: Loan Application
fields.description: Set once this lead is converted (status = Converted).

fields.label: Eligibility Check Notes
fields.description: Reasons from the last run_eligibility_check() call. Pre-screening only — never a credit decision (spec §1.4, §2.2); the lender's D4 underwriting is out of scope for this platform.
